Title: Camzy: Export Tesla dashcam video with driving data overlaid | Product Hunt
## Export Tesla dashcam video with driving data overlaid. Reviewing TeslaCam footage shouldn’t be a chore. Camzy is built for Tesla owners who need clarity and control. The built-in Tesla player works for quick checks. Camzy goes further: 🎥 6-camera synced playback with driving data 🗺️ Map-based browsing to find clips instantly ⚡ Smart jumps to Sentry and Dashcam events 📦 Batch backup and deletion 💎 Clean exports with timestamp and speed overlays From insurance claims to road trip memories, Camzy makes TeslaCam effortless. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Camzy. I’m JohnFu, co-founder of Camzy. My co-founder @vibrissa and I are both Tesla owners, and reviewing TeslaCam footage was always more painful than it should be—small screens, slow scrubbing, and way too much guessing just to find one moment. Especially when you actually need the clip, like for an insurance claim or police report. We built Camzy to feel native on iPhone and turn that “slow task” into a 10-second workflow—using things like map-based browsing, synced multi-camera playback, and batch exports. 🎥 6-camera synced playback with driving data. 🗺️ Map-based browsing to find clips instantly. ⚡ Smart jumps to Sentry and Dashcam events. 💎 Clean exports with timestamp and speed overlays. If you use TeslaCam, we’d love to hear what frustrates you most—or what you wish existed. What's the accuracy of the GPS tracker? I wonder if you can share this data with insurance companies. The GPS info is taken from TeslaCam metadata and watermarked on the exported video. Accuracy-wise, it’s the same data your Tesla records during the drive. Congrats on the launch — love the **Tesla-first** workflow and rich, overlaid driving context.​. We put a lot of effort into polishing the UI — really glad it shows 🙏. With Camzy, you can easily export and merge your Sentry/Dashcam footage into a single, shareable clip like this:. **It’s that simple and intuitive.** Beyond just merging, Camzy overlays essential driving data directly onto your video, including:. overlaying speed and timestamps is the real MVP feature here raw tesla footage often lacks that context for insurance. does the app burn those overlays permanently into the exported video file?
